verdict.rationale: Paxos documents a conversion endpoint for executing conversions between supported assets. It also offers one-call orchestrations for minting (USD to stablecoin) and redeeming (stablecoin to USD to bank), plus held-rate quotes in its v2.0 API, so quotes and executed fiat↔stablecoin conversions are clearly first-class. The only documented rate is the 1:1 USDG redemption, and the evidence never states conversion fees or settlement times. Missing for 10: documented conversion fees, documented settlement times for conversions, explicit stablecoin-to-stablecoin conversion pairs, held-rate quotes shown to apply to stablecoin conversion and not only brokerage trading, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
